theme_and_archetype.reasoning: The user requested a modern, minimalist blue, white, and black palette. Archetype 4 delivers the necessary structural clarity and authority (black/white contrast) for a social and professional 'learn-to-earn' platform, while the rich blue serves as the kinetic trigger and primary brand identifier. It avoids the chaotic 'dribbble' look and grounds the user in a premium, clean experience.

typography.primary_font_usage: Headings, titles, and key metrics. Provides a structural, raw yet premium aesthetic.
typography.secondary_font_usage: Body text, captions, UI labels, tags. High legibility with modern geometry.

spacing_and_layout.feed_layout: max-w-2xl mx-auto flex flex-col gap-8 pb-24 md:pb-8
spacing_and_layout.general_rules: Use generous spacing. Don't center-everything; left-align data and text. In the feed, ensure media goes full-width inside the container without side padding, like Instagram.

navigation.mobile: Fixed bottom bar (h-16), backdrop-blur-xl bg-background/80, 1px top border. Icons: Home, Explore, Upload (primary circle), Courses/Gigs, Profile.
navigation.desktop: Fixed left sidebar (w-64 or w-72), border-r, h-screen p-6. Vertical links, large spacing.

feed_post.header: Flex row, avatar (w-10 h-10 rounded-full), bold username, muted timestamp, 'more' icon right.
feed_post.media: aspect-[4/5] or 16:9, rounded-xl object-cover mt-3 mb-3 w-full border
feed_post.actions: Flex row, heart, comment, share icons. Bookmark on right.
feed_post.content: Likes count (bold text-sm), Username + Caption (text-sm), tags (text-blue-500).

upload_modal.container: Fixed inset-0 z-50 flex items-center justify-center bg-black/60 backdrop-blur-sm
upload_modal.modal_body: bg-background rounded-2xl w-full max-w-xl max-h-[80vh] overflow-hidden flex flex-col
upload_modal.actions: Shadcn Textarea for caption, subtle tags input. File upload dropzone with dashed border and generous p-12.

profile.header: Flex row items-center gap-6 p-6. Large avatar (w-24 h-24), stats (Posts, Followers, Following), Bio, 'Edit Profile' or 'Follow' button.
profile.grid: Grid cols-3 gap-1 md:gap-4. Square aspect ratio for thumbnails.

explore_courses_gigs.layout: Grid layouts. Courses use aspect-video cards. Gigs use flat bento-style list items with 'Apply' buttons.

interactions_and_motion.hover: Subtle -translate-y-1 on cards. Buttons must change to a lighter/darker hue explicitly (e.g., hover:bg-blue-700/90).
interactions_and_motion.theme_toggle: Smooth transition using CSS variables. Background should use transition-colors duration-300.
interactions_and_motion.testing: All interactive elements MUST have data-testid attributes (e.g. data-testid='upload-submit-btn').

implementation_instructions_to_main_agen: Install Phosphor Icons or Lucide-react for the clean, structural icons required.
Use Tailwind variables mapped to HSL or HEX for complete Day/Night control. Example: bg-background, text-foreground.
Do NOT use standard HTML <select> or <input type='date'>. Always use Shadcn UI customized without the 'Vercel default' look. Strip heavy box-shadows.
Build a Left Sidebar layout for md: screens and above, and a Bottom Navigation bar for mobile view.
Set the main container for the Feed to max-w-2xl, and the Explore/Courses to max-w-5xl/7xl using CSS grid.
Add 'data-testid' to all core functionalities (login, upload, like, comment, toggle).
